import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_70/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_70/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation_history: JOIN on ["order_id","order_id"]
# Join df0 and df1 on 'order_id' (inner join by default)
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="order_id", how="inner")

# Select and rename columns to match target schema:
# Target schema: 
# ['order_id': string, 'order_status': string, 'order_approved_at': string, 
#  'product_id': string, 'seller_id': string, 'price': float, 'freight_value': float]

# From df_joined, pick columns:
# order_id (string) - from join key
# order_status (string) - from df0
# order_approved_at (string) - from df0
# product_id (string) - from df1
# seller_id (string) - from df1
# price (float) - from df1
# freight_value (float) - from df1

# Ensure types match target schema:
# order_id, order_status, order_approved_at, product_id, seller_id as string (object)
# price, freight_value as float

# Convert columns to correct types explicitly
df_result = df_joined[[
    "order_id",
    "order_status",
    "order_approved_at",
    "product_id",
    "seller_id",
    "price",
    "freight_value"
]].copy()

# Convert to string type for string columns
for col in ["order_id", "order_status", "order_approved_at", "product_id", "seller_id"]:
    df_result[col] = df_result[col].astype(str)

# Convert to float type for numeric columns
for col in ["price", "freight_value"]:
    df_result[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_result[col], errors='coerce')

# Save the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_70/target_multisource.csv"
df_result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
